```yaml
type:
- Enhancement
description: |
  - Add force-push approval path for review-chain breaks (PER-128)
  - Track `chain_break`/`remote_ref`/`remote_head` through packet build and status
  - Require a `--lease` matching recorded remote head for force-push
  - Render chain-break UI section and force-push confirmation in packet/approval pages
title: |
  Support approving a force-push on review-chain breaks (PER-128)
changes_diagram: |
  ```mermaid
  flowchart LR
    buildClj["review-packet build.clj\n(--remote-ref/--remote-head)"] -- "sets" --> modelClj["model.clj\nchain-break facts"]
    modelClj -- "packet.json" --> kkPacket["kk-packet.sh\nextract chain_break/remote_*"]
    kkPacket -- "events" --> libApproval["lib/kk-approval.sh\nfold chain_break/remote_*"]
    libApproval -- "status facts" --> kkApproval["kk-approval.sh\nstatus output"]
    kkApproval -- "facts" --> kkPacketApproval["kk-packet-approval.sh\ndecide force-push + lease"]
    kkPacketApproval -- "grants" --> gatekeeper["Gatekeeper\nforce-push w/ lease"]
    libApproval -- "facts" --> approvalClj["approval.clj\nchoices + lease"]
    approvalClj -- "view" --> approvalCljs["approval.cljs\nUI: lease, chain-break"]
    modelClj -- "chain-break" --> renderClj["render.clj\nbreak-section"]
    kkReviewPacket["kk-review-packet.sh\nremote-ref/remote-head"] -- "args" --> buildClj
  ```
